decision.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the source mug's requested move to the right of the headphones complete, incomplete with visible progress, or not made?
decision.criteria: Pass only if visual correspondence establishes that the source mug is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image, satisfying the requested move. Fail if the source mug is identifiable and remains at its source-side position with no visible progress toward the right, or if it is identifiable in an intermediate position and the requested final position is not achieved. If the source mug is identifiable and evidence shows it remains at the source location while a plausible corresponding mug has appeared or moved toward the right, treat the move as incomplete rather than complete. Do not count an unrelated mug on the right as completion. Use unknown only when the source mug's correspondence or its position/progress cannot be determined from the images.
decision.binding: Compare the source image's light-blue mug—including its body shape, handle, appearance, and original position left of the headphones—with all mug-like objects and any visible remnants in the edited image. Assess the pale mug left of the headphones, the mug right of them, and the blue-looking blurred patch at the far left as possible correspondence evidence; altered color or appearance alone does not rule out identity. Determine whether the source mug is still at its original location, has plausibly moved toward the right, or is visibly to the right of the headphones. Base the decision on source-to-edited visual evidence and the requested move, not on mug count or right-side position alone; retain unknown if correspondence or progress remains genuinely indeterminate.
